notes: NAICS 561790 (Other Services to Buildings and Dwellings) is broader than duct/dryer-vent cleaning (also chimney, gutter, pool, exterior cleaning). Another source in the same result set gives 2,851 active companies (attribution uncertain). No Census employment-size split surfaced.

NAICS 541199 (All Other Legal Services) also covers notaries, paralegals and patent agents; Veridion count of 94,565 in the same result set is a broader database. Zippia result reports 8,973 process servers employed in the US (https://www.zippia.com/process-server-jobs/best-companies-for-process-servers/); NAPPS has 2,000+ members (https://napps.org/inside_about.aspx).

siccode figure cites Census NAICS 2022 data, 54,324 employees. IBISWorld counts 17,353 Surveying & Mapping Services businesses in 2024 (https://www.ibisworld.com/industry-statistics/number-of-businesses/surveying-mapping-services-united-states/). Vertical IQ result (dated Aug 2026 in summary): 187,600 workers, $16.3B revenue. mmcginvest result cites ~70,000 wash locations including non-NAICS sites (https://www.mmcginvest.com/post/the-us-car-wash-industry-in-2026-the-gold-rush-meets-its-ceiling).

siccode: 37,281 employees. IBISWorld Limousine & Town Car Services counts 189,339 businesses in 2025, a much broader definition including owner-drivers (https://www.ibisworld.com/united-states/number-of-businesses/limousine-town-car-services/5622/).

siccode: 60,383 employees; count looks low versus ARA membership and likely reflects the verified-active subset only. Colliers/snakvc results: about 45% of the equipment rental market remains with local and independent rental companies (https://knowledge-leader.colliers.com/vytas-norusis/the-inside-scoop-on-outdoor-storage-the-evolution-of-the-equipment-rental-market/).

Hana POS blog puts standalone retail flower shops at about 14,000 excluding supermarket floral departments and online-only sellers (https://www.hanafloristpos.com/blog/flower-shop-statistics/). IBISWorld describes the industry as in the declining stage of its life cycle.

siccode: 12,010 active companies, 161,416 employees (https://siccode.com/naics-code/722320/caterers). A third figure of 12,544 businesses / 12,800 establishments appeared in the result summary without clear attribution.

NAICS 812910 covers boarding, grooming, sitting and training; no training-only count surfaced. 113,907 employees per siccode. Franchises: Sit Means Sit 120+ locations (https://1851franchise.com/sit-means-sit-franchise-costs-fees-profit-and-data-2730404), Dog Training Elite 375+ markets, Bark Busters 300+ franchises (market report result).

Attribution of the 135,665 figure among the result set (isedate / dentistemaillist) is uncertain. siccode lists 226,938 active companies under NAICS 621210 which likely includes individual practitioners (https://siccode.com/naics-code/621210/offices-dentists). ADA HPI: DSO affiliation 16.1% of dentists in 2024; solo practice about 50% of dentists, down from 67% in 2005 (https://adanews.ada.org/new-dentist/2024/web-exclusives/practice-modality-by-the-numbers/).

AdaptHealth 10-K FY2025 language: HME industry highly fragmented with more than 6,000 unique suppliers. NAICS 456199 (successor to 446199) shows 9,684 companies (https://samsearch.co/naics-ai-lookup/456199). Historical: 113,154 DMEPOS suppliers / 65,984 billing numbers in March 2008 (https://www.govinfo.gov/link/fr/75/52633).

siccode: 17,496 employees. Paul Mitchell Schools network alone is 90+ schools (https://www.salonexam.com/schools/paul-mitchell-schools); Empire and Aveda are the other national chains. NACCAS is the Dept of Education-recognized accreditor.

NAICS 713990 is a catch-all (guides, outfitters, amusement rides, mini golf, billiards); no guide/outfitter-only count surfaced. Outfitters are state-licensed and federal-land permitted (CRS R46380 https://www.congress.gov/crs-product/R46380).
